add_rc_deps(resource.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/setup.ico)

# wusa.exe is all Rust (wusa-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wusa-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wusa.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wusa-rust/src/wusa/wusa.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(wusa_res OBJECT resource.rc)
target_compile_definitions(wusa_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(wusa_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WUSA_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(wusa wusa-cargo wusa.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE wusa-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wusa_res ${WUSA_REUSED})
